verdict.rationale: Qodo runs autonomously in the background on pull requests. Once connected it automatically reviews every PR, and reviews can be set to trigger automatically with control over when they run. It also auto-publishes risk labels and enforces standards across repositories without manual intervention. These automations are limited to the built-in PR-review workflow, which is configurable through the portal or .pr_agent.toml, rather than user-defined automations. Missing for 10: user-defined or custom automation workflows, scheduled or event triggers beyond PR review, background agent tasks outside code review, and independent hands-on corroboration of autonomous operation.
